item.title: Hidden implant in Ledger hardware wallets linked to $93M theft
item.dc:creator: Zeljka Zorz
item.description:
Three days after customers in Southeast Asia began reporting drained wallets, Ledger says the damage is limited to devices sold through a regional reseller. On-chain researchers put suspected losses at more than $93 million.

item.title: Let's Encrypt TLS certificate lifetimes to drop from 90 to 64 days starting February 2027
item.dc:creator: Zeljka Zorz
item.description:
Websites that rely on Let's Encrypt will soon have to renew their TLS certificates more often. Starting February 10, 2027, the certificate authority will issue certificates valid for 64 days by default, down from 90 days.

item.title: Kubernetes misconfiguration exposes internal dashboards to the public internet
item.dc:creator: Staff Writer
item.description: A cloud security survey found that a large share of Kubernetes clusters run containers with over-permissive identity and access settings, leaving enterprise dashboards reachable from the internet.
